qa.question: Should Units 5 and 6 be 229 MW each instead of 225 MW?
qa.finding: The Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality draft permit memo from September 2026 (https://okdeqonbaseexternal.databankcloud.com/pav/api/Document/AWtoGCCMAPa3ZmzV9bv2lNVdjzgKUd4GV4oRCuMNP0goK6NykmHJHyG5WSO1mUZe7mM1J5HwOpKpJWodbQLKNmw%3D/?ViewerMode=PDF&ForceDownload=true) lists two 229 MW GE turbines. The permit application from late 2025 said 222 MW each. The AEP report says 450 MW in total.
qa.recommendation: Leave 225 MW on both units, since 450 MW in total matches the AEP report. Change to 229 only if you prefer the permit figure.
qa.note: The Southwest Power Pool entry ERAS-2025-023 at https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GIActive is a single combustion turbine of 513 MW nameplate and 510 MW capacity at the Northeastern 345 kV substation, with commercial operation in December 2029 in the open list at https://opsportal.spp.org/Studies/GenerateActiveCSV, read on 5 November 2026. It does not match two 229 MW turbines due by the end of 2028. The same Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality permit file also describes a separate large turbine of nominal 453 MW at Northeastern (https://okdeqonbaseexternal.databankcloud.com/pav/api/Document/AS0IjaCrV1T%C3%81SEUDdXmwkZpG2VRBClzAKR911pep%C3%81uAtGhYCcgV7UJnH1xPqDg4ZbOaSJTShXSL302lcWYvl9ds%3D/?ViewerMode=PDF&ForceDownload=true). The permit and the AEP report describe two turbines for Units 5 and 6.

qa.question: Should the Oil and Gas Watch and Sierra Club entries for Unit 3 be updated to operating?
qa.finding: The AEP report for June 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/4904/000000490426000059/aep-20260630.htm) says Unit 3 has run on natural gas since January 2026.
qa.recommendation: Keep Unit 3 as operating in GEM. Tell the owners of the Oil and Gas Watch and Sierra Club lists that their proposed and planned labels look out of date.
qa.note: I could not read the Oil and Gas Watch page, so I did not see its own source documents.

qa.question: Is the SPP queue entry ERAS-2025-023 a separate project from Units 5 and 6?
qa.finding: The 513 MW queue entry is one turbine with commercial operation in December 2029, a year after the two 229 MW turbines of Units 5 and 6. The queue list names no developer, and no document I found ties it to either project.
qa.recommendation: Add no new unit now. Check the Southwest Power Pool list again in the next monthly update and the Oklahoma Corporation Commission docket for a third Northeastern turbine.
qa.note: An Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality permit file for Northeastern also describes a separate 453 MW turbine (https://okdeqonbaseexternal.databankcloud.com/pav/api/Document/AS0IjaCrV1T%C3%81SEUDdXmwkZpG2VRBClzAKR911pep%C3%81uAtGhYCcgV7UJnH1xPqDg4ZbOaSJTShXSL302lcWYvl9ds%3D/?ViewerMode=PDF&ForceDownload=true). The entry may be that turbine or a later one. I could not tell which from a document.
